description: The reviewers' specification of purchaseDecision (P01.T04a §5 table; ADR-0015 item 3), written independently of packages/policy/src/billing-state.ts. The first rule whose every listed dimension matches a row decides it. scripts/billing-decision-tables.mjs generates purchase-decision.tsv from these rules, and tests/billing-decision-tables.test.mjs checks the library against every row. A Shopify-bound or Shopify-route workspace is refused every Morrow action in every row.

dimensions.name: action
dimensions.meaning: The purchase action: seven Morrow actions, and two Shopify actions on store A.

dimensions.name: link
dimensions.meaning: Whether store A's link is current. An open workspace has no link.

dimensions.name: payer
dimensions.meaning: The relevant payer's recorded facts (morrow_direct: the workspace account; Shopify: store A's account): an active account with an active entitlement, or a past-due one. It is billable only with a live subscription and, on Shopify, a current link. Unfixed phases have no payer.

dimensions.name: subscription
dimensions.meaning: Whether that payer's subscription is terminal (cancelled, or uninstalled on Shopify).

rules.source: open: every other Morrow action needs a plan first.
open: the Shopify actions belong to the Shopify route.
Shopify phases: every Morrow action is refused (ADR-0015 item 3).
Shopify phases: the plan page while the store's link is current.
Shopify phases: no plan page for a store that is not linked.
shopify_bound: no usage cap before a plan.
shopify_app_pricing: a usage cap when the store's own payer is billable.
shopify_app_pricing: otherwise the store's payer is not billable.
morrow_direct: a linked store is never charged through App Pricing (ADR-0015 item 3).
morrow_direct: resubscription after a terminal subscription.
morrow_direct: one subscription; change it instead.
morrow_direct: a top-up needs a billable workspace.
morrow_direct: no top-up without a billable subscription.
morrow_direct: change_plan, update_payment_method, cancel, billing_portal and view_invoices.
